news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹66.73 (vs ₹53.64 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹66.73 (up from ₹53.64 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹60.0b (up 21% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹33.0b (up 24% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 55% (up from 53% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 16% growth forecast for the Capital Markets industry in India.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 19%
news.body: After last week's 19% share price gain to ₹3,386, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 44x. Average forward P/E is 31x in the Capital Markets industry in India.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: There is 1 new director who has joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 1 new director. 4 experienced directors. 4 highly experienced directors. Nominee Director Sidharatha Mishra was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited (NSEI:ICICIAMC) agreed to acquire an additional 5.88% stake in HDFC Bank Limited (NSEI:HDFCBANK).
news.body:
ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited (NSEI:ICICIAMC) agreed to acquire an additional 5.88% stake in HDFC Bank Limited (NSEI:HDFCBANK) on February 10, 2026. Upon completion, ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited will hold 9.95% stake in HDFC Bank Limited. The transaction has been approved by the Reserve Bank of India. news.title: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited (NSEI:ICICIAMC) agreed to acquire 9.95% stake in IDFC First Bank Limited (BSE:539437).
news.body:
ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited (NSEI:ICICIAMC) agreed to acquire 9.95% stake in IDFC First Bank Limited (BSE:539437) on February 11, 2026.

The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory board / committee. The RBI, while granting the above referred approval has also conveyed that if the Applicant fails to acquire major shareholding within a period of 1 (one) year from the date of aforesaid RBI letter, the approval shall stand cancelled.

news.title: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited (NSEI:ICICIAMC) and ICICI Bank Limited (NSEI:ICICIBANK) agreed to acquire 9.95% stake in Bandhan Bank Limited (NSEI:BANDHANBNK).
news.body:
ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited (NSEI:ICICIAMC) and ICICI Bank Limited (NSEI:ICICIBANK) agreed to acquire 9.95% stake in Bandhan Bank Limited (NSEI:BANDHANBNK) on February 10, 2026.

The transaction has been approved by Reserve Bank of India.

news.title: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited Announces Executive Changes
news.body: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited at its Board of Directors meeting held on January 14, 2026, approved the appointment of Mr. Ankur Kagrana as a Senior Management Personnel (SMP) and designating him as the Chief Risk Officer with effect from January 20, 2026. Pursuant to the same, Mr. Sumit Gupta would cease to be an SMP of the Company with effect from closure of business hours of January 19, 2026. Mr. Kagrana had joined the AMC in December 2007 and currently manages the Internal Controls function. He would be designated as the Chief Risk Officer (CRO) of the Company. As the CRO, he would be responsible for the overall risk management of the Company and report to the Managing Director. news.body: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited at their meeting held on January 14, 2026 approved the payment of interim dividend of INR 14.85 per equity share for the period ended December 31, 2025 to the equity shareholders of the Company, whose names appear in the Register of Members of the Company or in the records of Depositories as beneficial owners of the shares as on January 21, 2026, being record date fixed for this purpose.
